propositions: When structured parse retries exhaust OUTPUT_RETRIES in _pai_structured's prompted branch, the raw reply text is currently discarded and unrecoverable; opt-in artifact capture is needed for debuggability.

A new config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir (resolved in LLMConfig.from_env via _llm_str and env alias REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR) must gate opt-in local capture of final-attempt reply, model id, contract name, and attempt count as a timestamped file.
The artifact write must be best-effort (non-fatal I/O errors swallowed) and must never mask the original parse error; the original exception is raised unchanged.
Artifact rotation must keep at most 20 newest files per directory by mtime to prevent unbounded growth on unattended hosts.
Default (key unset) must preserve byte-for-byte current behavior with zero artifacts written, maintaining the durable no-response-text posture.
